sources.title: GitHub - Vish2503/Text2SQL-Qwen: Text2SQL run locally using Qwen2.5 ...
sources.snippet: Text2SQL-Qwen is a local Text-to-SQL application powered by Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct-GPTQ-Int4. It converts natural language questions into executable SQL queries, integrates directly with PostgreSQL, and features a FastAPI backend with a Streamlit-based UI for interactive use.

sources.snippet: Qwen2.5 is the latest series of Qwen large language models. For Qwen2.5, a range of base language models and instruction-tuned models are released, with sizes ranging from 0.5 to 72 billion parameters.
